corpname.part: Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library Special Collections

did.abstract: Collection consists of mounted black and white and color reproductions of Pre-Columbian arts, including architecture, sculpture, ceramics, and illuminated manuscripts from Mexico, Central America and the Andean region of South America. Content varies from original photographic prints to reproductions from magazines and other published sources. Some sections have accompanying clippings folders.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Collection consists of mounted black and white and color reproductions of Pre-Columbian arts, including architecture, sculpture, ceramics, and illuminated manuscripts from Mexico, Central America and the Andean region of South America. Content varies from original photographic prints to reproductions from magazines and other published sources. Some sections have accompanying clippings folders.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Arranged by medium. Sub-arranged by format or type; also by country, region, culture and site name.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: This collection was originally stewarded by the Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library at Yale Library. In July 2026, the collection's stewardship was transferred to Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library.
